title: Two Pointers
intuition: Use two index markers to scan array from different directions or speeds to find pairs or scan sequences in O(n).
step_by_step_strategy: Initialize left at 0, right at len - 1.
Compare elements or sum at pointers.
Adjust pointers toward each other based on conditions.
Terminate when pointers meet or cross.
common_mistakes: Incorrect update conditions causing infinite loop
Applying on unsorted data without sorting first
